AI_coding.W02: retain automated_ai, human_validation=false, exploratory; 9 indeterminate citations remain indeterminate
AI_coding.W03_supplement: only under a separately prospectively frozen AI coding plan; freeze exact grader IDs, prompts, agreement rule and bounded adjudication before W03 outputs are inspected; no human-validation accuracy claim

collection_binding.identifier_lock_limit: A frozen requested identifier does not guarantee unchanged hosted weights, aliases, provider defaults or platform behavior. Record returned identifiers and platform metadata and disclose changes.

implementation.canonical_request_profile_digest: SHA-256 over UTF-8 json.dumps(profile, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon)), with no appended newline. Environment variable names are included; credential values never are.
implementation.input_contract: All 80 planned I03 logical slots per wave, including technical missingness; one retained response per slot; the input must be bound to an archived technical audit and original response hashes.
implementation.profile_change_rule: The implementation omits the primary numerical contrast when profile digests differ. A separately archived prospective comparability review would require an explicit versioned update; no automatic pooling.

origin.W02_exposure: W02 outputs and descriptive citation-pattern summaries had already been inspected before the question and analysis were chosen. W02 analyses remain exploratory.
origin.prospective_scope: W03 observations have not been collected or inspected. The pre-W03 specification is prospective for W03 only.
origin.superseded_sensitivity: Earlier v0.1 bootstrap draft is superseded. No bootstrap, confidence interval, p value or service ranking is planned here.

paper_working_title: Within-wave and between-wave variation in source URL strings in Japanese and English API responses from four generative AI service lineages

primary_contrast.cell_match: same site, item form hash, language, lineage, condition and window class, plus prospectively reviewed material request profiles

leave_one_response_out_sensitivity.interpretation: descriptive sensitivity range, not a confidence interval
leave_one_response_out_sensitivity.output: minimum and maximum defined contrasts plus number of undefined omission combinations
leave_one_response_out_sensitivity.procedure: omit one retained response from each wave; evaluate all cross-wave omission combinations within each originally eligible cell

primary_contrast.model_or_material_settings_change: report as changed deployment/configuration; no same-model causal interpretation; no silent pooling
primary_contrast.name: W03 minus W02 mean within-cell Jaccard, separately in each eligible lineage-language cell
primary_contrast.temporal_pairing: replication numbers are not matched subjects across waves
primary_contrast.undefined_similarity_cells: report; omit numerical contrast; retain all observations

primary_metric.both_empty: undefined, excluded from similarity mean and counted separately
primary_metric.name: within_cell_mean_pairwise_exact_URL_set_Jaccard

registration_evidence: The enclosing public Git commit and its provider timestamp are the immutable registration record. This is a GitHub prospective analysis registration, not a new Zenodo or OSF deposit.
scope: Separate derivative URL analysis for a W02/W03 empirical paper; not an amendment to Core confirmatory outcomes
secondary_descriptive_metrics: number of distinct exact first-five URL sets with actual denominator; direct comparison of this count only for equal response counts
share of valid responses with no extracted URL
lowercase exact hostname set Jaccard using the same five URLs; no registrable-domain merging
cross-wave set overlap reported as exploratory, not independent pair observations

sharing_and_governance.execution_gate: Private PI authorization remains required before enabling the collector. Public registration and a generated manifest do not authorize collection.
sharing_and_governance.future_changes: Append a dated version before W03 output inspection; retain this version. Changes after exposure must be marked deviations/exploratory.
sharing_and_governance.institutional_determination: Do not infer institutional ethics approval or exemption. Carry forward a documented applicable determination or confirm it in the private final review.

url_extraction.hostname_parse_failure: Retain the exact URL for the primary metric, omit an unparseable/missing hostname from the secondary hostname set, and report the count of such occurrences.
url_extraction.limits: URL-free bibliographic citations and semantic source identity are outside this metric
url_extraction.reference_script: Historical W02 citation_patterns.py (content hash below); literal selection rule is implemented in automation/url_set_variation.py
url_extraction.rule: citations URLs then regex URLs in displayed text; rstrip period/comma/semicolon; first occurrence deduplication; first five; order-insensitive exact URL set
